text:
auditor_kim: Hi all — auditor here. We need evidence for SOC2 CC6 and ISO27001 A.9 for an RBAC change on 2025-12-01 01:15:00Z in inference-prod (org:redwood-main). Can you produce a cross-system trace (RBAC change -> KMS usage -> SSO/mfa) plus a short control mapping and any vuln/incident notes?
rachel: Copy. Which files/formats do you want? Checksums?
auditor_kim: CSV + raw JSON for each system, plus a small manifest.csv listing filename, sha256, exported_by, export_time, source_host. Also a mapping doc that ties each evidence file to control clauses.
devin: I'll pull rbac_changes entries (including before/after payloads) from auth-primary-read. SQL I'll run:```sql
SELECT id, principal_id, change_type, changed_by, created_at, payload_before, payload_after FROM rbac_changes WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2025-12-01T01:00:00Z' AND '2025-12-01T01:30:00Z';
```
arjun: I'll query CloudTrail for KMS uses on alias/aws/redwood-kms-prod (region eu-west-1). Filter: eventSource:kms.amazonaws.com AND (eventName:Decrypt OR eventName:GenerateDataKey) AND eventTime BETWEEN window. I'll include userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer and requestParameters.ciphertextBlobHash.
tom: I'll export Okta session logs + oidc token introspection results to map human sessions -> principal_id. Okta query: /api/v1/logs?since=2025-12-01T00:55:00Z&until=2025-12-01T01:35:00Z&filter=eventType eq "user.session.start" or eventType eq "mfa.challenge.succeed".
evidence-bot: Export job queued: job=exp-4021 by devin. ETA 3m.
infra-bot: Note: read replica used auth-read.eu-west-1; no locks. Access audited.
devin: RBAC export complete. Upload: s3://redwood-audit-exports/6790012345/rbac_changes-20251201.csv (sha256: 4f2c8d9b...). Raw JSON: rbac_changes-20251201.json (sha256: 9f86d081...). README included mapping columns -> control text.
arjun: KMS CloudTrail slice uploaded: s3://redwood-audit-exports/6790012345/kms_cloudtrail-20251201.json (sha256: 8b1a9953...). Normalized CSV: kms_events-20251201.csv (sha256: 45c48cce...). NOTE: found one failed Decrypt at 2025-12-01T01:17:42Z for principal service:svc-analytics; error=AccessDenied. Flagging for triage.
tom: Okta logs uploaded: s3://redwood-audit-exports/6790012345/okta_sessions-20251201.json (sha256: c20ad4d7...). Mapping file okta_to_principal.csv included. All human principals in RBAC changes had MFA events within 90s.
rachel: Control mapping doc (SOC2 CC6 + ISO A.9) uploaded: s3://redwood-audit-exports/6790012345/control_map_CC6_A9.pdf (sha256: 6f1ed002...). Summary: CC6.1/A.9.2 -> rbac_changes row; CC6.2/A.9.4 -> KMS CloudTrail; CC6.3/A.9.3 -> Okta session logs.
auditor_kim: Good. For the failed decrypt by svc-analytics, can you confirm if that maps to the RBAC change principal or a separate service account? Also add any vulnerability triage notes if relevant (we're seeing CVE-2025-3001 referenced in recent advisories).
arjun: svc-analytics is a machine principal, not part of the RBAC change set. The failed Decrypt had missing encrypt context -> AccessDenied. I queried previous hours and see successful decrypts for svc-analytics earlier; looks like a different ciphertext context. No immediate CVE link.
devin: No RBAC change for svc-analytics in our export. RBAC change affected principal agent-ops (role escalate -> infra-admin) done by user rachel at 2025-12-01T01:15:09Z. payload_before shows role=infra-sre, payload_after role=infra-admin.
rachel: I made the change as requested by incident playbook (ticket INC-7822). Added runbook note.
auditor_kim: Please add an exception record in the control mapping for svc-analytics failed decrypt with owner analytics-team and ticket #7823. Also include remediation steps and timeline.
rachel: Added exception row in control_map_CC6_A9.csv with owner analytics-team -> ticket 7823 -> remediation: review encrypt-context usage and rotate key-policy bindings.
tom: I've included an oidc token introspection snippet in README to reproduce mapping. Playbook excerpt:```bash
# RBAC export
psql -h auth-read.eu-west-1 -c "COPY (SELECT id, principal_id, change_type, changed_by, created_at, payload_before, payload_after FROM rbac_changes WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2025-12-01T01:00:00Z' AND '2025-12-01T01:30:00Z') TO STDOUT WITH CSV HEADER" > rbac_changes-20251201.csv
# KMS CloudTrail query (awsctl)
awsctl cloudtrail query --source s3://ct-logs/eu-west-1/ --filter "eventSource:kms.amazonaws.com AND (eventName:Decrypt OR eventName:GenerateDataKey)" --start 2025-12-01T01:00:00Z --end 2025-12-01T01:30:00Z > kms_cloudtrail-20251201.json
```
evidence-bot: Bundle created: s3://redwood-audit-exports/6790012345/evidence_bundle_v1.tar.gz (sha256: ad023482...). Presigned link: https://presign.redwood-internal/s/6790012345/evidence_bundle_v1.tar.gz (expires in 72h).
auditor_kim: Thanks. Final asks: 1) Include statement of log retention and source hosts (auth-read.eu-west-1, cloudtrail S3 path eu-west-1, okta tenant redwood-eu). 2) A short attestation line from security that exports were generated from read-only replicas and checksums verified.
rachel: Added retention note: logs retained 1 year hot, 5 years cold archive. Source hosts noted. Security attestation included in README (signed by rachel).
auditor_kim: Excellent. I'll ingest and reply with any follow-ups. Please keep the thread open 48h.
arjun: Noted. If auditor needs raw CloudTrail S3 object path we can arrange secure transfer under NDA.
auditor_kim: Appreciate it. Closing for now — thanks team. :thumbsup:
rachel: ✅
